description: This file defines a Java interface for representing responses to 'Sudo' commands in the 'thingsearch' service of the Eclipse Ditto project. It aggregates common behaviors and provides default implementations for resource path and type retrieval.

classes.name: ThingSearchSudoCommandResponse
classes.description: A Java interface that defines the structure and behavior of responses to 'Sudo' commands in the 'thingsearch' service. It extends multiple interfaces to include command response features, entity handling, and an ID placeholder.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path is not currently needed for SudoCommands.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with the 'ThingSearchSudoCommand', indicating the type of resource the response pertains to.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the JsonValue entity in the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders in the response.
